Pൺඋඍ III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 10.07.2024
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, hereby declare, under Sub - section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land/servitude described in the Column 1 below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the Provisions of that Act. In Column 2, it is described from which land that the servitude is acquired.

01. Description of the Servitude.– Acquisition of servitude right over the Allotmnent of land in which the access road constructed for the salinity barrier erected across the Ambathale Kelani river and for the quarters.

02. Description of the Land.– All that allotment of land described as following name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. GA/BIY/2019/226 and dated on 31.05.2019, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Bollegala, in Bollegala Grama Niladhari Division, No. 278/A, in Adhikari Pattuwa Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Biyagama, in Gampaha District, Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Pelawatta – Extent: 0.1381 Hectare North: Road, Land of which the name of the land the claimant cannot be found, marshy land claimed by Somalatha Gunawardhana and Pelawatta; East: Land of which the name of the land and the claimant cannot be found, marshy land claimed by Somalatha Gunawardhana and Pelawatta; South: Pelawatta claimed by Somalatha Gunawardhana; West: And Land claimed by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, Pelawatta claimed by Somalatha Gunawardhana, marshy land claimed by N.A.R. Palitha and land of which the name of the land and the claimant cannot be found..
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/18/2018/WS/447.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.07th February 2024.
